from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-353ebe5f.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    patterns = []
    for r in {0, h - 1}:
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            while c < w and grid[r][c] == 0:
                c += 1
            start = c
            while c < w and grid[r][c] != 0:
                c += 1
            if c > start:
                patterns.append(grid[r][start:c])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            value = grid[r][c]
            if value == 0 or r in {0, h - 1}:
                continue
            candidates = [(pattern, pattern.index(value)) for pattern in patterns if value in pattern]
            if not candidates:
                continue
            pattern, index = candidates[0]
            start = c - index
            for offset, digit in enumerate(pattern):
                col = start + offset
                if 0 <= col < w:
                    out[r][col] = digit
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_353ebe5f', program_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print(program_path, 'saved; transform:', mod.transform)
